info.name: MBG System API - Updated
info.description:
Complete API documentation for MBG Food Distribution Management System.

## Features
- Authentication with JWT
- Role-based access control (SUPERADMIN, PIC_DAPUR, PIC_SEKOLAH, DRIVER)
- Auto-calculate IMT & Status Gizi for students
- QR Code system for delivery tracking
- Photo upload for checkpoints

## Roles
- **SUPERADMIN**: Full access to all resources
- **PIC_DAPUR**: Manage kitchen, menu, checkpoints, delivery
- **PIC_SEKOLAH**: Manage school, students, classes, attendance
- **DRIVER**: Scan QR codes for delivery

## Base URL
Local: http://localhost:3000

## Authentication
All endpoints except login require Bearer token in Authorization header.
